p2Appearance.windowScope: Window fields inherit site colors when unchecked. Overrides stay local to this window.
p2Appearance.siteScope: Site defaults apply to inheriting windows and icon labels. Editor panels keep their own colors.
p2Appearance.contentScope: Content colors affect document text, gallery captions and link-list surfaces. Headings, links and author-colored tiles keep their own colors.
p2Appearance.moduleIndependent: This module keeps its own content colors. Title, frame and icon-label overrides still apply.
p2Appearance.lowContrast: {{field}}: minimum sampled contrast {{ratio}}:1 (small text target 4.5:1). Adjust the background or reset the text override. Manual colors remain allowed.
p2Appearance.wallpaperCheck: Transparent labels over patterns or images require visual checking. An opaque label background provides a known contrast pair; this is not wallpaper accessibility certification.

documentCompatibility.imageReadOnly: Image content is read-only in this editor.
documentCompatibility.title: Editor update required
documentCompatibility.paused: Autosave and publishing are paused. Your unsaved edits remain in this tab.
documentCompatibility.recoveryHelp: Download your local canonical draft, then check the server. Open a fresh editor in another tab and compare the backup before reapplying edits. This tab will keep its draft and will not retry automatically.
documentCompatibility.openFresh: Open fresh editor in new tab

documentCompatibility.ready: The latest server response is compatible. A new editor tab will load the current cloud draft; this tab keeps your unsaved edits.
